svg.title: Toonverse wireframe 01: Authentication
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe, not a final UI design · Toonverse Task 011 (0.11) · Desktop-first (Issue #17 D5)
Already have an account? Log in
On success: go to /dashboard. Loading: button shows
After log in, returns to the page the user came from.
Guest status is browser-only: no server record (D1).
You are browsing as a guest. Your work is not saved.
Guests can use Discover, the Reader view and the
sandbox. Guest drawings are never saved or
Password must be at least 8 characters.
Client checks mirror the server rules (Task 3.23).
401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS: the same message for a
wrong email or a wrong password (Task 3.10).
Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
429 RATE_LIMITED: 5 attempts a minute per IP address.
A user suspended while logged in loses access on
their next request and returns here (Task 12.4).
Exact wording: to be finalised in Task 3.24.
"Continue as guest" stays below the main button.
The guest banner wraps to two lines; the
Error banners sit above the form.
Issue #17 D3: the guest entry point is shown
here; the full sandbox is in Module 06.
Decision log D1: guests use Discover, Reader
and the sandbox; drawings are never saved.
valid email, password at least 8 characters
